title: From Idea to Launch Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 18
description:
Zoya needs a new laddoo, but one wrong guess could waste a month of Nani's work. So how do companies create new products without guessing blind? In this animated lesson we follow Laddoo Lab, a millet laddoo brand from a Bengaluru home kitchen, as it turns six ideas into one new product: the cocoa-ragi laddoo.

You will see what new product development means, Kotler and Armstrong's eight steps from idea to launch, and Robert Cooper's Stage-Gate idea from 1990. Then we watch all eight steps live: idea generation, screening against three rules, a concept test with twenty tiffin parents, marketing strategy, business analysis, batch after batch in Nani's kitchen, a two-week test market with forty families, and the launch. We look at why each step costs more than the one before, and new product development at work today in a phone maker, a bank, a food delivery app and a carmaker. The human side: the steps cut costly flops, but testing takes time and a rival may copy you first.

This is Episode 18 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
